description: A quiet cream ragdoll kitten with stitched cloth seams, a warm orange apron, tiny brass accents, and a soft plush tail.

idle.notes: Calm breathing and blinking loop with tiny apron and tail micro-movement.

walk.notes: True directional walking rows for gentle rightward and leftward movement.

curious.notes: Soft head tilt and nose-down inspecting loop with no external prop.

happy.notes: Restrained pleased response with a brighter smile and tiny paw raise.

sleep.notes: Compact tucked sleeping pose with apron still visible.

follow.notes: Gentle follow-ready trot support loop; not a replacement for true directional walking.

shy.notes: Small timid tuck-and-recover loop used as the shy support state.

stretch.notes: Soft stretch-and-settle loop remapped onto the fixed jumping row.

drag.notes: Directional drag reuses the true left-facing and right-facing walk rows.

follow.notes: Implemented as a soft follow-ready support loop in the fixed running row.

shy.notes: Implemented as a timid tuck-and-recover loop in the fixed failed row.

stretch.notes: Implemented as a stretch-and-settle loop in the fixed jumping row.

roll.notes: The fixed 8x9 atlas budget was used for stretch support instead of a separate roll row to keep silhouettes clearer and calmer.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses the true left-facing walking row
right drag uses the true right-facing walking row
walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
head, eyes, body, apron, tail, and paw rhythm all agree with travel direction
Mallow remains readable at small size as a cream ragdoll kitten with an orange apron, visible stitches, and a soft plush tail
